about: §31 (docs/multisig-machines.md): the parent-Safe guard. A request from a site may never make this account act for a Safe it owns — a multisig on this device's list (`known`) or one whose isOwner(signer) reads true. `input` is vela_core::app::parent_safe_guard::CheckInput; `expect` is check(input) (ParentVerdict). `answers` are the shell's answers to ReadSafeOwner (SafeOwnerAnswer); `at_submit` is the submit chokepoint's form, where a Safe nobody read is refused 'unchecked'. Replayed by rust/crates/vela-core/tests/app_parent_safe_guard.rs, wasm (parentSafeCheck, verify-web), uniffi (parent_safe_check: Android JVM, iOS XCTest), the desktop, and the signing page's own suite (the page cannot read the chain, so it refuses every refused or read shape here on any target).
